# Projected capture and unchanged superclass consumer

Independent Java 25 sources write a bounded captured token and wide value
before an observable parent constructor. A witnessed class-metadata-only edit
removes the worker's local formal declaration and gives it its existing owner
method enclosure; every original Code attribute and descriptor stays identical.
The constructor's captured type is projected while its Sink<? super Self>
argument is unchanged. The immutable parent and observers exercise field state,
virtual dispatch, callbacks and exact failures before parent completion.
No application data is used.
